ids=list(AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m, numConfs=160, randomSeed=12720, numThreads=6, pruneRmsThresh=0.15))

records=[]
for cid,(status,energy) in zip(ids,res):
 xyz=np.array(m.GetConformer(cid).GetPositions()); coords=xyz[nis]; av=coords.mean(axis=0); cent=coords-av; u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(cent.T@ideal); d=np.linalg.det(u@vt); rotate=u@np.diag([1.,1.,d])@vt; oriented=(xyz-av)@rotate
 nerr=np.linalg.norm(oriented[nis]-ideal)**2

for r in records[:20]:print(r[:6],flush=True)
np.savez('/tmp/conf.npz',data=np.array([r[-1] for r in records[:20]]),scores=np.array([[r[0],r[1],r[2]] for r in records[:20]]))
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'/tmp/tmc_h.mol')

a=np.load('/tmp/conf.npz'); xyz=a['data'][8];print('chosen',a['scores'][8]);
